properties.name: annotationStore.url
properties.description: The url of the annotation container in the annotation store (required)

properties.name: annotationStore.defaultContainer
properties.description: Fallback default container takita will try to write to in annotation server

properties.name: repository.staticPath
properties.description: The path to the manuscript repository

properties.name: repository.baseUrl
properties.description: The base URL of the manuscript repository server (required)

properties.name: sparqlQuery.urlPrefix
properties.description: The url prefix of the sparql query used for the http request (required)

properties.name: devIndex.size
properties.description: The size of the dev index. It represents the number of manuscripts.

properties.name: takita.feedbackLink
properties.description: Link to provide user with functionality behind feedback button in UI (for example a mailto: link)

properties.name: exist.idPrefix
properties.description: sometimes the xml:ids have been prefixed with a String (optional)

properties.name: takita.security.success-url
properties.description: url to open on successful authentication

properties.name: takita.templates.addons
properties.description: folder to lookup custom thymeleaf templates within templates folder (default: 'projectspecific')
